verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a full suite of official SDKs (web, mobile, server, game engines) sharing a unified identity/event model and API surface, backed by an installer wizard, HTTP V2 ingestion endpoint, and a published OpenAPI spec, all discoverable via llms.txt/docs.md for AI-native consumption. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK integration ease and no explicit AI-agent-specific SDK usage examples beyond the MCP server.
